update_rule: New verified defects must be recorded on a PR to main with evidence, diagnosis, regression test status and owner; never erase an OPEN error without exact-run evidence.

records.diagnosis: Existing MCP get_market_bars accepts 1m/5m/15m/1h, not 1d. Historical D1 repair exists in open PR #749, not deployed.
records.mandatory_action: Do not call vendor OpenD D1-broken; fix cloud MCP consumer 1d contract and verify exact deployed SHA.

records.diagnosis: US cloud closed-bar finality proof absent; a bar is_closed field in historical snapshot does not independently establish provider finality.
records.mandatory_action: Preserve all Radar trade admission BLOCKED; collect provider callback and finality during actual RTH.

records.diagnosis: QQQ/NVDA/GLDM aggregate VWAP sometimes outside same-bar OHLC. Suspected turnover/volume aggregation mismatch; source semantics not verified.
records.mandatory_action: Quarantine derived VWAP; inspect provider amount units, fix aggregator and exact-head regression before claiming clean.

records.diagnosis: Cross-read source sequence can drift while producer and consumer publish; permanent mismatch not proven.
records.mandatory_action: Atomic capture/recheck source revision+runtime+sequence, do not equate health heartbeat with aligned Radar analysis.

records.diagnosis: GitHub Actions 15m XNYS cron code merged in #931; actual scheduled execution and Discord receipt have not been verified.
records.mandatory_action: Require distinct proof for cron trigger, SSM success, new bars, analysis, Discord HTTP acceptance and client receipt.

records.diagnosis: Cloud 60m normalization row count below required threshold; #927 handles valid 1-3 intraday bars but is not deployed.
records.mandatory_action: Differentiate legitimate partial 60m day vs invalid daily depth; rerun after exact patch/environment change only.

records.diagnosis: Gold ETF observation MCP had Tencent fallback; source provider was not TickFlow despite status PASS.
records.mandatory_action: Reject any provider other than TickFlow for A-share validation; do not call fallback PASS.

records.diagnosis: Cloud minute endpoints had incorrect route; intraday resolutions require TickFlow intraday endpoint rather than D1 getter.
records.mandatory_action: Use provider official endpoint by resolution and verify Windows NativeSDK five periods first.

records.diagnosis: GitHub success denotes code/test transport, not qualified live data, bar finality, provider ownership, notification or trade readiness.
records.mandatory_action: Report CI, deployment, source qualification, Radar signal admission, and notification as separate gates.

records.diagnosis: GitHub main vs deployed EC2 version can diverge; same-source worker heartbeats alone do not prove current main was deployed.
records.mandatory_action: Verify expected immutable main, deployed LiveFeed/Radar/MCP SHA and canonical snapshot provenance independently.

records.diagnosis: Repeated commands against identical failing revision/environment produced no new engineering evidence.
records.mandatory_action: STOP duplicate retry; require distinct root-cause hypothesis, code change, environment correction or targeted evidence.

records.diagnosis: Livefeed HEALTHY heartbeat and LV3 rights do not establish current trading-session market K-line delivery.
records.mandatory_action: Measure last provider bar and push callback, compare against US session time; guard weekend/premarket separately.

records.diagnosis: The first self-improvement ai-governance run rejected valid TickFlow symbols and endpoint signatures because its token schema forbade '.'; the initial backend-gate failed as a consequence.
records.mandatory_action: Keep dotted official symbols/endpoints valid and run the real ai-governance script plus focused regression on exact PR head before claiming registry compliance.

records.diagnosis: Actual PR #934 exact-head backend CI job 2/3 failed three engineering-autonomy loop cases: newly added unknown-incident recorder incorrectly validated SHA256 queue fingerprint with a 40-hex Git commit SHA validator. A queue fingerprint is 64 hex digits; commit SHA stays 40.
records.mandatory_action: Use independent exact validators for the 64-character queue SHA256 and 40-character Git commit SHA, run loop fail-fast test and incident receipt regression at the same PR head; do not simply retry unchanged CI.

records.diagnosis: The main-branch Engineering Autonomy 120m workflow installed only pytest, but its fixed queue commands invoked pytest with tests/conftest.py enabled. The global application conftest imports anyio/FastAPI/httpx and failed before the reviewed autonomy tests ran. The failure was captured on run 39439612414 at main SHA 7e1ca0edc7be2c099bf3638ead49f994a2cefde1. Protected main fix #945 was independently exercised in fresh run 39443606247 (30+24 tests, PASS) and exact-cache recovery 39443918486 (PASS, attempts unchanged at one per task).
records.mandatory_action: Keep --noconftest on the exact reviewed pytest-only queue commands. Preserve exact queue fingerprint/cache checks; use fresh runs after queue changes. PASS applies only to fixed offline queue execution, not AWS deployment, continuous AI coding or trading.

records.diagnosis: Windows standalone audit counted same-session 1m ETF float-drift rows as research-label eligible before post-close, while the isolated cache builder only permits the 1m float-tolerance path after 15:02 China time. This overstated standalone live research coverage; it did not change production cache, Radar or trading admission.
records.mandatory_action: If live-session 1m drift becomes research-eligible before post-close on main, diagnose the new deviation against the exact source revision. Preserve the post-close research-only route and NOT_VERIFIED finality; do not repeat provider reads for the fixed classification defect.

records.diagnosis: Main isolates insufficient history for non-core allow_scan_symbols as NO_DATA/INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY while preserving valid siblings; fixed core symbols still fail closed. PR #988 adds intraday_batch-path coverage through cache publication and reader behavior; exact-head CI run 39768002692 and Research Radar run 39768002581 passed, merged as 1d0ad09de27dbc9b8961fdbaca4aca4af8884354. No deployment or live expanded-universe run was verified; current cloud evaluation remains four ETFs, so this is code-path mitigation only.
records.mandatory_action: Before enabling expanded scans in production, verify the exact deployed SHA, a bounded canary with per-symbol NO_DATA, valid-sibling cache publication, sequence advancement, and historical-reader output. Keep source, Radar, and trading admission blocked; do not repeat the unchanged sparse-history provider case.

records.diagnosis: Known symbol-local turnover quality flags aborted valid sibling intake. Initial PR #961 also failed to skip quarantined snapshots and incorrectly blocked healthy inter-closure polls. Adversarial tests reproduced five failures before convergence. Live readback after deployment also showed global source closure oscillating independently of valid research observations; event source proof gating must not be conflated with technical research polling. Fixes #961/#964 merged and worker deployed at 3cb68e6084a935ca1f8adacd6fd30d1c9e008510 via run 39627400747; live readback across 57146..57158 showed research UNCHANGED with PARTIAL GLDM quarantine. This mitigates batch research blocking, not provider turnover anomalies, whole-session reliability or trade admission.
records.mandatory_action: Skip known unhealthy snapshots, isolate flagged closed bars without masking structural errors, retain quarantine diagnostics, allow healthy NO_NEW_CLOSED_BAR polls; verify exact deployed worker/source SHA and cloud readback before marking resolved. Keep event/source admission blocked for UNPROVEN/UNKNOWN source proof while allowing fresh schema-valid provisional research; preserve event gate status on unchanged polls.

records.diagnosis: The CN historical adapter clipped explicit 15m/1H date ranges to a 365-day provider lookback, and stockdata-hub's symbol+period cache does not distinguish date ranges. Regression tests on main 339e419 reproduced both periods requesting only 365 days for a 2016-to-2026 query. The adapter fix now passes the bounded full range and bypasses the cache for explicit starts; actual EastMoney history back to 2016 remains NOT_VERIFIED because the read-only provider probe was disconnected before returning data.
records.mandatory_action: Keep explicit intraday lookbacks bounded and bypass the range-unaware cache. Before claiming 2016 coverage, verify observed earliest/latest timestamps and source identity for 000001 at both 15m and 60m; keep provider finality and all Radar/trading gates independent.

records.diagnosis: The clean-retry fix (#968) exposed the underlying failure on exact main run #61: AWS CLI v2 ZIP extraction still returned ENOSPC in the probe's /tmp staging directory before any TickFlow provider call. Repeated extraction retries cannot fix a volume-capacity limit. Exact main run #39715081279 at SHA e491727 confirmed pinned SDK import and one realtime_quote operation completed; sanitized output intentionally omitted quote values. No K-lines, depth, WebSocket, retries, Radar admission or trades were used.
records.mandatory_action: Keep the pinned boto3/botocore bootstrap and do not restore AWS CLI archive extraction. If the same bootstrap path fails on a new SHA, investigate the new signature first. This mitigation proves only a single realtime quote operation; quote values, currentness, K-lines, bar finality and all Radar/trading gates remain independently unverified/blocked.

records.diagnosis: The main-branch Premium probe now explicitly requests 159611.SZ and 159209.SZ, and the sanitizer preserves both targets in its receipt. PR #985 passed exact-head backend CI (run 39765338157) and Research Radar Tests (run 39765338170), then merged as 622fd230a7b08dc596a7752c559bc3610dc05248. No AWS provider request was made; actual quote values, receipt delivery, source currentness, and all admission gates remain unverified.
records.mandatory_action: If the owner-authorized quote-only AWS probe is run, verify the sanitized receipt lists exactly 159611.SZ and 159209.SZ; report provider response, timestamp and latency separately. Keep currentness, volume/amount units, bar finality, cross-source parity, Radar admission and trading gates independently blocked until verified.

records.diagnosis: The isolated research collector routed 15m/60m warmup requests through TickFlow's intraday endpoint, which returns current-session bars only. Historical klines.get/batch support explicit start_time/end_time; the collector must fetch historical warmup separately and retain intraday only for current-session updates.
records.mandatory_action: Use bounded explicit history windows through TickFlow klines.get/batch for 15m, 60m and D1; merge with current-session intraday bars by label; enforce 96/24/60 warmup rows and fail closed with ROW_COUNT_BELOW_MIN. Keep source, timestamp semantics, currentness, finality and all Radar/trading gates independently unqualified until exact deployed SHA and cloud readback are verified.

records.diagnosis: The AWS private-frame progress auditor capped D1 at 40 rows while the cache writer requires 60, so valid D1 history became UNKNOWN diagnostics. It also labeled 145-240 one-minute rows as 97_TO_144. Exact-base offline regression reproduced three failures; the focused 27-test suite passes with aligned D1 cap and an accurate 145_TO_240 enum. This is diagnostic mitigation only; exact-head CI and post-merge cloud audit remain separate.
records.mandatory_action: Keep private-frame maximums aligned with the real cache writer and update the workflow enum allowlist together. Verify each period at its writer limit and one row above; reject oversize frames and export no prices or timestamps. Do not interpret off-session sequence stability or repaired diagnostics as currentness, finality or Radar/trading admission.

records.diagnosis: AWS audit 39901934538 confirms the collector rejects the separate current-session hourly increment under the historical four-row minimum. A normal morning has zero, one or two elapsed hourly bars, so valid multi-session warmup is discarded and Radar publishes no evaluation. Deterministic batch and single-route morning regressions fail on the base revision; missing-evaluation reader also suppresses independent heartbeat evidence.
records.mandatory_action: Validate sparse current-session increments separately and merge into strictly validated history; preserve all row checks, quarantine, depth and admission restrictions. Verify exact deployed collector/Radar/MCP SHA and in-session readback independently. Missing evaluation must expose bounded independent worker heartbeat, never source/data PASS.

records.diagnosis: After collector 152881d5 deployment, direct TickFlow D1 read returned 59 rows with required_rows60 because the count60 window included today and normalization quarantined the forming daily date. Intraday historical-only reads also correctly reject same-day vendor-float rows; callers need an explicit session-progress contract rather than mislabeling those rows historical.
records.mandatory_action: End D1 history before the current Shanghai date; preserve request limits. Use explicit session-progress intraday plus historical D1 for the five-period session reader. Radar must retain all row/continuity checks and record_only/currentness/finality restrictions. Verify exact-head CI, deployment and current-session source/consumer readback independently.
